standard-dialogue.npc: Welcome to Lowe's Archery Emporium. Do you want to see my wares?

standard-dialogue.text: If the player is carrying a Combat path voucher and hasn't received all possible rewards yet:

steps.player: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.

steps.text: If the player hasn't claimed their rewards yet and has no inventory space:

steps.npc: I will be able to give you your reward when you have some space for it.

steps.text: If the player hasn't claimed their rewards yet and is on a free-to-play world:

steps.npc: Why yes, here are some high-quality iron arrows.
I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.

steps.text: If the player hasn't claimed their member rewards yet and is on a free-to-play world:

steps.npc: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.

steps.text: If the player hasn't claimed their rewards yet and is on a members world:

steps.npc: Why yes, here are some high-quality iron arrows.

steps.text: If the player has another open inventory space:

steps.npc: Since you are a member, I'll also give you extra arrows and one of my finest bows.
I sell a variety of range equipment in my shop if you wanted to take a look.
Is there anything else I can do for you?

steps.text: If the player does not have any more open inventory spaces:

steps.npc: I do have more rewards for you, but you need some free space for me to give you the rewards.
Can I help you with anything else?

steps.text: If the player has only claimed the free-to-play rewards and is on a members world:

steps.npc: Why yes, here is one of my finest bows and some high- quality iron arrows.
I sell a variety of range equipment in my shop if you wanted to take a look.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
